title: Meyniel's Conjecture
context_text: Meyniel's conjecture from 1985 is the most famous open problem in the cops and robber game. The best known upper bound prior to this paper is $\operatorname{cop}(G)\leqslant n/2^{(1-o(1))\sqrt{\log n}}$, obtained independently by Lu and Peng (2011) and Scott and Sudakov (2011). This paper extends that bound to the vertex cover number parameter.
paper_contribution: Proves that every connected graph with vertex cover number $k$ has cop number at most $k/2^{(1-o(1))\sqrt{\log k}}$, giving the first sublinear upper bound on the cop number in terms of the vertex cover number.
paper_title: Cops and robber in graphs with bounded vertex cover number

title: Problem 9
statement_text: Is it true that for connected graphs $G$, $\operatorname{cop}(G)=o(\mathrm{td}(G))$?
context_text: In the cops and robber game, cops first choose vertices of $G$ (several may share a vertex), then the robber chooses a vertex; in each subsequent round every cop stays or moves to an adjacent vertex, then the robber does the same, and the cops win if some cop eventually occupies the robber's vertex. The cop number $\operatorname{cop}(G)$ is the minimum number of cops that can guarantee a win. The treedepth $\mathrm{td}(G)$ of a connected graph is the minimum number of vertices on a root-to-leaf path of a rooted tree whose closure (each vertex made adjacent to all its descendants) contains $G$ as a subgraph; it satisfies $\operatorname{tw}(G)+1\le\mathrm{td}(G)\le\operatorname{vc}(G)+1$, where $\operatorname{vc}(G)$ is the vertex cover number (minimum size of a set meeting every edge), so it lies between treewidth and vertex cover number. Meyniel's conjecture asks for $\operatorname{cop}(G)=O(\sqrt n)$ on $n$-vertex connected graphs, and the best bound is $n/2^{(1-o(1))\sqrt{\log n}}$ (Lu–Peng, Scott–Sudakov). Graphs of treewidth $k$ have cop number at most $k/2+1$, and it is unknown whether this is asymptotically tight. The authors prove the first sublinear bound in terms of the vertex cover number, $\operatorname{cop}(G)\le k/2^{(1-o(1))\sqrt{\log k}}$ for connected graphs with $\operatorname{vc}(G)=k$, and ask whether this extends to treedepth. They note that $\operatorname{cop}(G)\le\frac12(\mathrm{td}(G)+1)$ follows easily from the treewidth bound, but do not see how to improve on it significantly.
paper_title: Cops and robber in graphs with bounded vertex cover number
